testRun.output: NO MEASUREMENT TAKEN. The one attached handset (38031FDJH00JVF) reports unauthorized and screencap returns exit 255 with 0 bytes. The only installed AVD (Television_720p, arm64 android-tv) sat at offline for ~12 minutes and never reached sys.boot_completed; killed.

implementation.summary: CaptureFloorMs left at 100ms with the reason written into its KDoc, plus the exact 5-step harness a human must run: device/resolution/link, a 60s session reading achieved fps and round-trip off TransportStats, a stopwatch wave test for end-to-end latency, a repeat with the dot grid covered vs visible to settle PRF-1, then set the floor just above the measured mean. NO FIGURE WAS INVENTED.

troubleshooting.resolution: Reported as not measurable with the exact procedure recorded, per the brief's instruction to prefer an honest 'not measurable here' over a fabricated number.

needsHumanReview.reason: HARDWARE GATE. AC-25 and AC-45 rest on an unmeasured capture rate. A human with an authorised Android device must run the 5-step harness in MirrorTuning's KDoc and either justify 100ms or change it. The NFR-1 waiver is re-flagged: F-2 otherwise ships with its performance budget unverified.
